headlines.title: Airbnb (ABNB) Brings 1 Million Listings Into A Major Card Travel Portal
headlines.summary: Airbnb (NasdaqGS:ABNB) and American Express announced a partnership integrating more than 1 million Airbnb listings into Amex Travel on 23 Oct 2026. Amex cardholders can now book Airbnb stays directly through Amex Travel and earn Membership Rewards on eligible reservations. Platinum card members receive added perks that include lodging credits on select Airbnb stays and statement credits on Airbnb Experiences.

headlines.title: American Express and Airbnb Launch Exclusive Partnership, Bringing Over 1 Million Listings to American Express Travel®
headlines.summary: NEW YORK & SAN FRANCISCO, October 22, 2026--American Express® (NYSE: AXP) and Airbnb (NASDAQ: ABNB) today announced an exclusive partnership, bringing over one million Airbnb listings around the world to Amex Travel, significantly expanding the ways eligible U.S. Card Members can plan, book, and earn rewards for travel.

headlines.title: Airbnb limits chores for guests, sparking backlash from hosts
headlines.summary: Hosts are threatening to leave the platform after Airbnb says that they can no longer require guests to strip beds or do other time-consuming cleaning chores.

description: Airbnb, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates a platform for stays, experiences, and services worldwide. The company's marketplace connects hosts and guests online or through mobile devices to book spaces, experiences, and services. It also offers gift cards. The company was formerly known as AirBed & Breakfast, Inc. and changed its name to Airbnb, Inc. in November 2010. Airbnb, Inc. was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
